mapper.insert: INSERT INTO inbound_order ( order_no, warehouse_id, status, remark, created_by ) VALUES ( #{orderNo}, #{warehouseId}, #{status}, #{remark}, #{createdBy} )
mapper.select: SELECT id, order_no, warehouse_id, status, remark, created_by, confirmed_by, confirmed_at, cancelled_by, cancelled_at, created_at, updated_at FROM inbound_order WHERE id = #{id}
SELECT id, order_id, sku_id, quantity, created_at, updated_at FROM inbound_order_item WHERE order_id = #{orderId} ORDER BY id
SELECT id, order_id, sku_id, quantity, created_at, updated_at FROM inbound_order_item WHERE order_id IN #{orderId} ORDER BY order_id, id
SELECT id, order_no, warehouse_id, status, remark, created_by, confirmed_by, confirmed_at, cancelled_by, cancelled_at, created_at, updated_at FROM inbound_order WHERE id = #{id} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE inbound_order SET status = 'CANCELLED', cancelled_by = #{cancelledBy}, cancelled_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3), updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'PENDING'

UPDATE inbound_order
SET status = 'COMPLETED', confirmed_by = #{confirmedBy}, confirmed_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3)
WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'PENDING'
